text.p: Mason-Dixon Bancshares Inc and the Concerned Shareholders Group said they have settled their litigation against one another.

Mason-Dixon will purchase all the Mason-Dixon shares owned by the Concerned Shareholders Gorup for $21.625 a share. The Concerned Shareholders Group, which owns a 5.1 percent stake, was pushing for the sale of the company.

The group and the company said in a joint statement on Friday that members of the shareholder group have agreed to refrain from submitting stockholder proposals or joining a group that intends to affect control of the company for three years.
Mason-Dixon and its directors have agreed not to authorize or make disparaging statements regarding CSG members for a three-year period.
The settlement is scheduled to be completed on Monday, June 23, 1997.
As of the end of the first quarter, Mason-Dixon had about 5.3 million shares outstanding.
